contracts.description: Immutable roadmap goal selection exported for bounded design.
contracts.name: enforced-planning.roadmap-goal-handoff

AuthorityRef.description: Reference one concern-specific authority at an immutable revision.

concern.description: Exact fact class or concern owned by the referenced surface.
concern.title: Concern

path.description: Repository-relative or governed external authority path.
path.title: Path

revision.description: Immutable commit, digest, or version observed by the handoff.
revision.title: Revision

AuthorityRef.title: AuthorityRef

CapabilityAdoptionBinding.description: Bind an existing capability to the consumer path that must actually use it.

adoption_proof.description: Evidence that will show the intended consumer actually executed the selected capability path.

canonical_seam.description: Repository symbol, interface, command, or other concrete entrypoint owned by the capability.
canonical_seam.title: Canonical Seam

capability_ref.description: Existing capability authority being adopted or displaced.

disposition.description: Explicit treatment of the existing capability; silent parallel implementations are forbidden.
disposition.title: Disposition

exception_reason.description: Visible bounded reason required only for an explicit reduced-capability exception.
exception_reason.title: Exception Reason

intended_consumer.description: Product path, scenario, service, or other consumer that must bind to the capability.
intended_consumer.title: Intended Consumer

replacement_ref.description: Accepted replacement authority required only when the prior capability is superseded.

CapabilityAdoptionBinding.title: CapabilityAdoptionBinding

EvidenceTarget.description: Name the exact future claim and the evidence class needed to support it.

claim.description: Bounded claim that the design and implementation should license.
claim.title: Claim

evidence_class.description: Minimum evidence class required for this claim.
evidence_class.title: Evidence Class

EvidenceTarget.title: EvidenceTarget

MaterialUnknown.description: Keep an unknown explicit and assign its permitted treatment.

question.description: Decision-relevant fact that is not yet known.
question.title: Question

treatment.description: How the unknown must be resolved rather than guessed.
treatment.title: Treatment

unknown_id.description: Stable packet-local identifier for the unknown.
unknown_id.title: Unknown Id

MaterialUnknown.title: MaterialUnknown

OwnerSelection.description: Name either the responsible role or the authority that must choose it.

decision_ref.description: Authority that must assign ownership when no owner is yet known.

kind.description: Whether ownership is known or needs a decision.
kind.title: Kind

owner_role.description: Responsible role when ownership is known.
owner_role.title: Owner Role

OwnerSelection.title: OwnerSelection

TypedDependency.description: Describe why the selected goal depends on another governed artifact.

condition.description: Observable condition under which the dependency is discharged.
condition.title: Condition

dependency_type.description: Meaning of the dependency rather than an untyped edge.
dependency_type.title: Dependency Type

target_ref.description: Authority that owns the dependency target.

TypedDependency.title: TypedDependency

output_schema.description: Immutable selection snapshot produced by project roadmapping.

audience_or_actor.description: Actor who receives value from the outcome.
audience_or_actor.title: Audience Or Actor

capability_adoptions.description: Exact reuse, extension, supersession, or visible-exception binding for each required capability.
capability_adoptions.title: Capability Adoptions

current_state_ref.description: Current-state authority consumed at selection time.

desired_outcome.description: Observable target state without implementation detail.
desired_outcome.title: Desired Outcome

handoff_id.description: Deterministic project, goal, and roadmap-revision identity.
handoff_id.title: Handoff Id

material_unknowns.description: Unknowns design must not silently guess.

non_claims.description: Claims this handoff does not license.
non_claims.title: Non Claims

objective.description: One bounded observable outcome passed to design.

objective_sha256.description: UTF-8 SHA-256 of the exact objective text.
objective_sha256.title: Objective Sha256

project_roadmap_ref.description: Roadmap authority that selected this goal.

required_capability_refs.description: Existing authorities for capabilities required by the goal.

selected_at.description: Timezone-aware time when the roadmap selected this goal.

success_or_readout.description: Frozen pass/fail criterion or exploratory decision readout.
success_or_readout.title: Success Or Readout
